# Jasmin Aziz

Jasmin Aziz is a Strategic Marketing and Communications Consultant based in the UK, working with values-led organisations on brand foundations, campaigns, content systems, and fractional marketing and communications leadership. AI fluency is built into how she delivers.

## Pages

- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/ — Homepage: overview of practice, defined services, and engagement shapes (fractional, advisory, one-off)
- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/services — Services: detailed descriptions of communications audit, brand and positioning, campaign strategy, content and editorial system, AI governance and training, and three engagement shapes (fractional, advisory, one-off)
- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/ai — AI, trust and communications: AI governance and training for values-led organisations. Adoption your board can stand behind, and training built on your team's real work.
- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/about — About: professional background, nine years across charity, heritage, and third-sector organisations, approach to strategic marketing and communications work
- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/contact — Contact: enquiry form, direct email, two working day reply
- https://www.jasminaziz.co.uk/legal — Legal: privacy policy, cookie policy, and terms of use

## Published work

- https://theeditai.co.uk — The Edit: an opinionated AI tools directory for charity, cultural and heritage comms teams, built and run by Jasmin Aziz. Every tool goes through checks on where the data sits, whether it trains on your content, nonprofit pricing and DPIA likelihood, and the tools that didn't hold up are published alongside the ones that did.
- https://jasminaziz.substack.com — Substack: weekly writing on strategy, communications, and AI
